parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b", max_tokens: 3000, messages: [ { role: "user", content: "Reorganize the following class notes into clear sections with headings. Merge or remove any repeated/duplicate points so each concept appears only once. Do not add any new concepts, facts, or information not already present. For each existing concept, add: a real-life application or example, the underlying logic/reasoning behind it, and a practical tip for using it effectively. At the end, add a Key Takeaways section summarizing only what's covered above. Respond using EXACTLY this plain text format with no extra commentary: ===NOTES=== (full restructured notes in markdown here) ===IMAGES=== (list ONLY concepts genuinely hard to visualize, max 3, one per line as: Concept: name | Prompt: image description - write nothing here if none qualify) ===END=== Notes: " + $json.data } ] }) }}

parameters.jsCode: const buffer = Buffer.from($json.fullHtml, 'utf-8'); const binaryData = await this.helpers.prepareBinaryData(buffer, 'index.html', 'text/html'); return [{ json: {}, binary: { data: binaryData } }];
